## 2026-09-22 (evening): why the storefront looked different in different places (GOV-011 audit)

The owner saw "different variations of the design, content, sections and Arabic". Five sources, each verified by a fresh probe, none of them a second theme:

1. **Live domain vs the React theme.** optimalx.com.sa still runs the Raed theme (version 499745075) with the custom-code-box skin behind maintenance mode; the React theme (Partners id 1938498306, repo `shekeww/optimalx`, branch `main`) has never been submitted or installed. Anything seen on the live domain is the old skin, not this build.
2. **Server HTML vs client render on the home page.** Category and goal links were resolved by a bare `useQuery` that the server never prefetched, so the SSR HTML carried search fallbacks while the client rendered category links. React reported a hydration mismatch and rebuilt the tree client-side, which is exactly the "two designs on localhost". Fix in flight (S2b): taxonomy links come from router loader data on both sides. Two other mismatches were fixed today: the bottom tab bar's active class (Twilight location empty during SSR) and the dev-only router devtools mount.
3. **Copy in two registers.** The owner's 2026-09-22 dialect edits (667 keys) lived on the live tree while the voice sweep rewrote them to MSA bucket by bucket; any preview taken mid-sweep showed a mix. The sweep finished at 19:57 with `check-copy` at 0 across 26 files; buckets 13, 15, 16 and 17 were applied from the writer's output without the adversarial review (session limit), flagged for a later review pass.
4. **Data-dependent sections.** With `OFFLINE_TAXONOMY=1` the preview shows 20 overlay categories (real category pages, resolved tiles); without it the store has zero categories and every tile falls back to `/search?q=`. The live store is in the second state until the owner creates the categories (or runs `scripts/salla-categories.mjs --apply`). Brands, guides, certifications and the newsletter hide themselves when their data is empty, so the home page is shorter on the live store than on the overlay preview.
5. **Locale prefix.** With `OFFLINE_LANGS=ar,en` the store is multilingual and `/` redirects to `/ar/`; without it (and on the live store today, English disabled) URLs have no prefix and `/en` redirects home.

Convergence: one theme (React, `main`), one composition (the theme's default home blocks; the Raed composition is empty and moot), one register (MSA, gates enforced), one data path (taxonomy from loader data; categories created by the owner). The owner's tooling committed and pushed the mid-sweep tree as `87d2fbe commit_editmsg` at 16:31; the next push replaces it with a green tree.

Preview quirk recorded: the dev server's route generator drops `/categories` from `app/routeTree.gen.ts` on its startup run while `pnpm build` emits it (`dist/server/assets/categories-*.js`), so `/categories` 404s in dev and typechecks red until a build regenerates the tree. Verify `/categories` on `pnpm preview` (workerd), not on `pnpm dev`.
